name: AWS Site-to-Site VPN
overview: AWS Site-to-Site VPN creates encrypted IPsec tunnels between on-premises/customer networks and AWS network gateways.
examSignals: Encrypted network connection over Internet to VPC: Site-to-Site VPN
Dedicated private connectivity with predictable throughput: Direct Connect; add VPN for encryption if required

compareWith.diff: Site-to-Site VPN connects network gateways; Client VPN connects individual remote users/devices.
